name: Mean Curvature Grid Computation
definition: Computes the mean curvature κ = div(∇f / |∇f|) at every active voxel using a single BoxStencil pass, avoiding intermediate grids.
summary: Mean Curvature Grid Computation calculates the average of principal curvatures by normalizing the gradient before differentiation, distinguishing itself from Laplacian methods by avoiding intermediate grids via a single BoxStencil pass.
